system.description: The priest invokes Gave's suffering, making an enemy within range bleed from open wounds. Each wound causes 1 damage that armor and natural protection cannot prevent. The victim must make a Situation roll of 12, modified by Psyche, to resist the psychological pain; on failure, they suffer -1 on Skill and Situation rolls for 1d6 hours.
system.summary: The priest prays that Gave will show the dimwalker’s enemies just how much the god suffered on that black oak.

powerLevels.effect: Increase the number of bleeding wounds by 1
Increase the power's range by 5 meters
